mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate signals a tightening monetary policy, which leads to higher borrowing costs and reduced business investment, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS increases by > 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in the unemployment rate indicates a weakening labor market, which leads to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real estate sales (HOUST) signals a strengthening demand side of the economy, which boosts corporate earnings and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances when HOUST is increasing.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a weakening supply side of the economy, which leads to reduced corporate earnings and investor pessimism, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when INDPRO declines > 1%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a tightening labor market, which leads to wage inflation and increased consumer spending, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200k and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances when PAYEMS increases > 200k and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) combined with an increase in consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals inflationary pressure with accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS decreases > 0.25% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS decreases > 0.25% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real disposable personal income (RSAFS) signals increased consumer spending power, which boosts corporate earnings and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances when RSAFS is increasing.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in GDP (GDPC1) combined with an increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a mismatch between supply and demand, leading to increased inflationary pressures and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 decreases > 0.5% and INDPRO increases > 1% in 1 quarter
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when GDPC1 decreases > 0.5% and INDPRO increases > 1%.
